answer: Pulse quorum: (1) a timing auditor fires a signed pulse at an unannounced second each epoch, and every identity must echo it within 250 ms from its own clock while three timekeepers log drift. (2) Two identities whose drift curves match within 0.02 s, or that echo from one host, are voided together and their $400 bonds slashed. (3) Each fake needs a live machine: $7 monthly plus 5,000 pulses, so 5,000 fakes cost $35,000 monthly. An honest operator keeps one machine on one island; a farm rents a canyon of hosts, and no saffron thread of shared clock hides two names.
